description: This file contains utility functions for sanitization, validation, and security purposes within the 'actionHandler' folder of the project. It includes functions for validating printable characters, IP addresses, URLs, MAC addresses, ports, IDs, time ranges, days of the week, SSID names, and string contents, as well as initializing a CSRF protection library.

methods.name: printableCharacters
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains only printable ASCII characters within a specified range.

methods.name: noSpace
methods.description: Checks if the input contains any whitespace characters.

methods.name: validLink
methods.description: Validates if the given string is a valid URL label (domain).

methods.name: validMAC
methods.description: Validates if the input string is a proper MAC address.

methods.name: validPort
methods.description: Checks if the port number is within the valid range 1-65535.

methods.name: validId
methods.description: Validates if the ID is within 1-256.

methods.name: validId_PC
methods.description: Validates if the parental control ID(s) are within 1-256, supporting single or underscore-separated IDs.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within an array.

methods.name: isValInRange
methods.description: Checks if a numeric value falls within a specified range.

methods.name: validURL
methods.description: Validates whether a URL string conforms to standard URL format for both HTTP/HTTPS and FTP protocols.

methods.name: validTime
methods.description: Validates start and end times ensuring correct format and that start is before end.

methods.name: validDays
methods.description: Checks if the input days are valid weekdays.

methods.name: valid_ssid_name
methods.description: Validates SSID names according to length, character set, and reserved name restrictions.

methods.name: is_allowed_string
methods.description: Validates that the string does not contain specific invalid characters.

methods.name: is_allowed_string_Hostname
methods.description: Validates hostname string absence of disallowed characters.
